questions.text: What does 'mammals' mean?
questions.discussion: Mammals are animals such as lions and elephants.

questions.text: Which group does a crocodile belong to?
questions.discussion: A crocodile is a reptile.

questions.text: Which group does a frog belong to?
questions.discussion: A frog belongs to the amphibian group. Amphibians can live part of their lives in water and part on land.

questions.text: Which group does a koi fish belong to?
questions.discussion: A koi fish belongs to the fish group.

questions.text: Which group does an eagle belong to?
questions.discussion: An eagle belongs to the bird group. Birds have feathers and beaks.

questions.text: Look at the animal chart. Which animal is a mammal?
questions.discussion: The chart places the lion in the mammals group.

questions.text: Look at the animal chart. Which group includes a salamander?
questions.discussion: Salamanders are amphibians.

questions.text: Look at the animal chart. Which animals are shown in the bird group?
questions.discussion: The bird group illustration shows an eagle and a duck.

questions.text: Look at the animal picture. Which animal is a reptile?
questions.discussion: The crocodile is shown among the zoo animals and is a reptile.

questions.text: Look at the animal picture. Which animal is a fish?
questions.discussion: The koi fish is the fish shown in the animal illustration.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'singa'?
questions.discussion: Lion is the English word for singa. A lion is a mammal.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'gajah'?
questions.discussion: Elephant is the English word for gajah. An elephant is a large mammal.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'buaya'?
questions.discussion: Crocodile is the English word for buaya. A crocodile belongs to the reptile group.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'katak'?
questions.discussion: Frog is the English word for katak. A frog belongs to the amphibian group.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'burung elang'?
questions.discussion: Eagle means burung elang.

questions.text: Which animal is a mammal?
questions.discussion: An elephant is a mammal. Mammals include animals such as lions and elephants.

questions.text: Which animal is an amphibian?
questions.discussion: A salamander is an amphibian.

questions.text: Which animal is a bird?
questions.discussion: A duck is a bird. Birds have feathers and beaks.

questions.text: Which animal lives in water and has gills?
questions.discussion: Fish live in water and breathe through gills.

questions.text: Which animal has scales and belongs to reptiles?
questions.discussion: A lizard is a reptile and has scales.

questions.text: What does 'last weekend' mean?
questions.discussion: Last weekend refers to the weekend before now.

questions.text: Complete: 'Last weekend, we ___ to the zoo.'
questions.discussion: Went is the past form of go.

questions.text: What is the past form of 'see'?
questions.discussion: Saw is the simple past form of see.

questions.text: What is the past form of 'have'?
questions.discussion: Had is the simple past form of have.

questions.text: What is the past form of 'feel'?
questions.discussion: Felt is the simple past form of feel.

questions.text: What is the past form of 'take'?
questions.discussion: Took is the simple past form of take.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence about yesterday.
questions.discussion: Yesterday refers to the past, so saw is the correct verb form.

questions.text: Complete: 'Bara ___ lunch at the cafeteria.'
questions.discussion: Had is the past form of have and describes Bara's lunch in the past.

questions.text: Which word means 'merasa' in 'I felt happy'?
questions.discussion: Felt is the past form of feel, meaning merasa.

questions.text: What does 'finally' mean?
questions.discussion: Finally is used to introduce the last event in a sequence.

questions.text: Which word means 'selanjutnya'?
questions.discussion: Next means selanjutnya. It is used to tell what happens after the previous event.

questions.text: Choose the correct sequence.
questions.discussion: First, then, next, and finally can show the order of events.

questions.text: Complete: 'Did you ___ the elephant?'
questions.discussion: After did, use the base form see.

questions.text: Which question is correct?
options: Did you went to the zoo?
Did you go to the zoo?
Did you goes to the zoo?
Do you went to the zoo?
questions.answer: Did you go to the zoo?
questions.discussion: Use did + subject + base verb: Did you go...?

questions.text: Choose the correct short answer: 'Did you see birds?' — 'Yes, ___.'
questions.discussion: Yes, I did is the short affirmative answer to a did-question.

questions.text: Choose the correct short answer: 'Did you see a snake?' — 'No, ___.'
questions.discussion: No, I didn't is the short negative answer to a did-question.

questions.text: What does 'What animals did you see at the zoo?' ask?
options: Hewan apa yang kamu lihat di kebun binatang?
Di mana kamu makan setiap hari?
questions.answer: Hewan apa yang kamu lihat di kebun binatang?
questions.discussion: The question asks about the animals someone saw at the zoo.

questions.text: Read: 'Bara went to the zoo with his parents.' Who went with Bara?
questions.discussion: The sentence says Bara went with his parents.

questions.text: Read: 'They had lunch at a cafeteria.' Where did they have lunch?
questions.discussion: The story says they had lunch at a cafeteria.

questions.text: Read: 'Finally, they saw beautiful birds.' What did they see finally?
questions.discussion: The word finally introduces the last activity: seeing birds.

questions.text: Which sentence is in the past tense?
options: We went to the zoo last week.
We go to the zoo every week.
We are going to the zoo now.
We will go to the zoo tomorrow.
questions.answer: We went to the zoo last week.
questions.discussion: Went is the past form of go, so the sentence is in the past tense.

questions.text: Which group has animals that are mammals?
questions.discussion: Lions and elephants are both mammals.

questions.text: Which group has animals that are amphibians?
questions.discussion: Frogs and salamanders are amphibians.

questions.text: Which animal group has feathers?
questions.discussion: Birds have feathers and beaks.

questions.text: Which sentence uses 'did' correctly?
questions.discussion: After did, use the base form see.

questions.text: A: What animals did you see? B: ___
options: I saw a lion and an elephant.
questions.answer: I saw a lion and an elephant.
questions.discussion: The answer uses saw to tell which animals were seen in the past.

questions.text: A: Did you go to the zoo last weekend? B: ___
questions.discussion: Yes, I did is the correct short answer to Did you go...?

questions.text: Which sentence tells how Bara felt?
questions.discussion: Felt is the past form of feel and tells Bara's feeling.

questions.text: Listen to the sound. Which animal makes this sound?
questions.discussion: The sound is a short simulated cat meow. The correct animal is a cat.

questions.text: Listen to the English word. Which animal is it?
questions.discussion: The audio pronounces the word elephant. An elephant is a mammal.
